 218→            self.endpoint,
 219→            data=body,
 220→            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "text/event-stream"},
 221→            method="POST",
 222→        )
 223→        try:
 224→            with urllib.request.urlopen(  # noqa: S310 - endpoint comes from config
 225→                http_request, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds
 226→            ) as response:
 227→                return response.status, response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

 239→    def _parse_events(self, status: int, text: str) -> LLMResponse:
 240→        if FIREWALL_MARKER in text:
 241→            raise LLMError(
 242→                "the Tencent web firewall blocked the request (HTTP %s); it never reached ADP"
 243→                % status
 244→            )
 245→        completed = None
 246→        for block in text.split("\n\n"):
 247→            data = "\n".join(
 248→                line[len("data:"):].strip()
 249→                for line in block.splitlines()
 250→                if line.startswith("data:")
 251→            )
 252→            if not data:
 253→                continue
 254→            try:
 255→                event = json.loads(data)
 256→            except json.JSONDecodeError:
 257→                continue  # the closing "data: [DONE]" frame, or noise
 258→            if not isinstance(event, dict):
 259→                continue
 260→            if event.get("Type") == "error":
 261→                error = event.get("Error") if isinstance(event.get("Error"), dict) else {}
 262→                raise LLMError(
 263→                    "ADP returned error %s: %s" % (error.get("Code"), error.get("Message"))
 264→                )
 265→            if event.get("Type") == "response.completed":
 266→                completed = event.get("Response")
 267→
 268→        if not isinstance(completed, dict):
 269→            raise LLMError("ADP sent no response.completed event (HTTP %s)" % status)
 270→        messages = completed.get("Messages")
 271→        reply = None
 272→        if isinstance(messages, list):
 273→            for message in messages:
 274→                if isinstance(message, dict) and message.get("Type") == "reply":

 276→        contents = reply.get("Contents") if isinstance(reply, dict) else None
 277→        if not isinstance(contents, list):
 278→            raise LLMError("ADP response.completed carries no reply message")

 280→            part.get("Text", "")
 281→            for part in contents
 282→            if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("Type") == "text" and isinstance(part.get("Text"), str)
 283→        )
 284→        if not answer.strip():

 286→
 287→        usage: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 288→        stat = completed.get("StatInfo")
 289→        if isinstance(stat, dict):
 290→            tokens = stat.get("TotalTokens")
 291→            if isinstance(tokens, int) and not isinstance(tokens, bool):
 292→                usage["total_tokens"] = tokens
 293→
 294→        return LLMResponse(
 295→            text=answer,
 296→            provider=self.provider_name,
 297→            model=self.model,
 298→            usage=usage,
 299→            finish_reason=str(completed.get("Status") or "") or None,
 300→        )

 125→class _Transport:

  85→## Lifecycle of a dispute
  86→
  87→`run_dispute` in `app/pipeline.py` walks one dispute through these steps, in this order,

  89→
  90→1. `run.started` — the system records the dispute id, category, LLM provider, confidence

1→"""The LLM interface every adapter implements, plus JSON-response parsing.
   2→
   3→One method: `complete(request) -> LLMResponse`. That is the whole contract, so an
   4→adapter can be swapped without touching agent logic.
   5→"""
   6→
   7→from __future__ import annotations
   8→
   9→import abc
  10→import hashlib
  11→import json
  12→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
  13→from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
  14→
  15→
  16→class LLMError(RuntimeError):
  17→    """The provider could not be reached, is misconfigured, or returned an error."""
  18→
  19→
  20→class LLMContractError(LLMError):
  21→    """The provider responded, but not with the JSON object the agent contract requires."""
  22→
  23→
  24→@dataclass(frozen=True)
  25→class LLMRequest:
  26→    """One prompt to one agent.
  27→
  28→    agent            which agent is asking ("rider_advocate", "driver_advocate", "judge")
  29→    system_prompt    role, output contract and hard rules
  30→    user_prompt      the case material: dispute intake, Evidence Pack, policy document
  31→    metadata         adapter-facing hints. Real adapters ignore it; the mock uses it to
  32→                     build deterministic responses. Never carries anything that is not
  33→                     already in the prompts.
  34→    """
  35→
  36→    agent: str
  37→    system_prompt: str
  38→    user_prompt: str
  39→    expect_json: bool = True
  40→    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
  41→
  42→    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
  43→        """Stable hash of the prompts — recorded with the case so a run is reproducible."""
  44→        digest = hashlib.sha256()
  45→        digest.update(self.agent.encode("utf-8"))
  46→        digest.update(b"\x00")
  47→        digest.update(self.system_prompt.encode("utf-8"))
  48→        digest.update(b"\x00")
  49→        digest.update(self.user_prompt.encode("utf-8"))
  50→        return digest.hexdigest()[:16]
  51→
  52→
  53→@dataclass(frozen=True)
  54→class LLMResponse:
  55→    """What came back, plus enough provenance to log it honestly."""
  56→
  57→    text: str
  58→    provider: str
  59→    model: str
  60→    usage: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
  61→    finish_reason: Optional[str] = None
  62→
  63→    def as_log_fields(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  64→        return {
  65→            "provider": self.provider,
  66→            "model": self.model,
  67→            "usage": self.usage,
  68→            "finish_reason": self.finish_reason,
  69→        }
  70→
  71→
  72→class LLMClient(abc.ABC):
  73→    """Interface every LLM adapter implements."""
  74→
  75→    provider_name = "unknown"
  76→
  77→    @abc.abstractmethod
  78→    def complete(self, request: LLMRequest) -> LLMResponse:
  79→        """Run one prompt. Raises LLMError on transport/config failure."""
  80→        raise NotImplementedError
  81→
  82→
  83→def parse_json_object(text: str, *, agent: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  84→    """Parse the JSON object an agent contract requires out of a model response.
  85→
  86→    Tolerates the two things models actually do: wrapping the object in a ```json
  87→    fence, and adding a sentence before or after it. Anything else is a hard failure —
  88→    a malformed response must never be silently repaired into a ruling.
  89→    """
  90→    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
  91→        raise LLMContractError("%s: model returned an empty response" % agent)
  92→
  93→    candidate = text.strip()
  94→
  95→    # Strip a fenced code block if the whole response is wrapped in one.
  96→    if candidate.startswith("```"):
  97→        body = candidate.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in candidate else ""
  98→        if body.rstrip().endswith("```"):
  99→            body = body.rstrip()[: -len("```")]
 100→        candidate = body.strip()
 101→
 102→    try:
 103→        parsed = json.loads(candidate)
 104→    except json.JSONDecodeError:
 105→        start = candidate.find("{")
 106→        end = candidate.rfind("}")
 107→        if start == -1 or end == -1 or end <= start:
 108→            raise LLMContractError(
 109→                "%s: no JSON object found in model response: %r" % (agent, text[:400])
 110→            )
 111→        try:
 112→            parsed = json.loads(candidate[start : end + 1])
 113→        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
 114→            raise LLMContractError(
 115→                "%s: model response is not valid JSON (%s): %r" % (agent, exc, text[:400])
 116→            ) from exc
 117→
 118→    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
 119→        raise LLMContractError(
 120→            "%s: expected a JSON object, got %s" % (agent, type(parsed).__name__)
 121→        )
 122→    return parsed
 123→
